messages:
hugo: Heads-up release train: starting a 36h deploy embargo across the train to roll a critical kernel security patch and investigate intermittent canary instability on the search-vae route. Please hold non-blocking merges/deploys.

ana: Which canaries are failing and what symptoms are we seeing?

hugo: Canary group eu-west-1-c and a small subset of model-router pods are showing P95 latency spikes >120ms and sporadic gctrace OOMs during high-batch embed + search traffic. Not a full region outage but risky for new rollouts.

lina: Infra will sequence the kernel rollout: patch one canary rack, observe 45m, then stagger across racks. We'll also toggle aggressive GC settings on the test nodes to compare.

ops-oncall: Will monitor latency, error rate, and memory RSS. I'll post the validation checklist and a dashboard snapshot when the first rack is patched.

hugo: Exception process if you must ship during embargo:
```
/req-deploy EMBARGO-KERNEL --pr <URL> --owner <name> --reason "hotfix"
```
Requires approvals: eng-sre lead + release manager + infra. Include rollback script and smoke tests.

tom: deploy-bot: embargo applied by hugo. Auto-rollforward disabled.

ana: Short-term mitigations: throttle /v1/search-vae to 15 rps for eu-west-1-c, reduce client-side batch sizes, and disable non-critical feature flags that fan out model scores.

hugo: Updated release calendar and runbook (internal). Embargo lifts in 36h unless we clear earlier. Next status update in ~2h or when the first rack passes validation. Please escalate regressions in this thread and add a short note to the postmortem doc after rollout.

deploy-bot: first-rack-patch started at 2026-02-10T14:05Z (automated).
